articles.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
articles.description: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

articles.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
articles.description: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.

articles.title: West warns of famine risk in Sudan as civil war grinds on
articles.description: Millions face acute hunger in Sudan as conflict, drought and funding cuts aggravate the humanitarian crisis.

articles.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
articles.description: Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner.

articles.title: Bolsonaro has fled to Miami after losing Brazilian election - report
articles.description: Flavio Bolsonaro has fled to Florida after losing Brazil's presidential election, according to local media.

articles.title: At least 62 killed and thousands displaced in gunmen attack in Nigeria
articles.description: At least 62 people have been killed after an attack in northeastern Nigeria, the country's emergency agency said.
